reason: Radix renders no content node while the tooltip is closed and creates it on the client inside a body portal. The server must ship the TooltipContent markup somewhere and the trigger (the controller host, a button) cannot contain it, so Tooltip::Content emits an inert <template> sibling at its call site. The template has no data-slot, generates no box and its content is not part of the document, so DOM node lists, boxes and accessibility match the oracle.
api: Tooltip::Content renders an inert <template data-shadcn--tooltip-template> (no data-slot) holding the content markup while closed
